title: On the use of transfer learning in nature-inspired algorithms: a systematic review
core_idea: A focused systematic review (excluding deep learning) that examines how transfer learning is integrated with nature-inspired algorithms. The work analyzes 47 primary studies, categorizing them by transfer-learning strategies, learning paradigms, and algorithmic goals, and outlines central challenges such as domain/task similarity, avoiding negative transfer, selecting what and when to transfer, and adapting transfer mechanisms to population-based search paradigms.
tldr: Systematic review of transfer learning applied to nature-inspired algorithms (47 studies, deep-learning approaches excluded), categorizing strategies and paradigms and identifying key integration challenges.
